method.source: frozen M1 difference rasters + common-valid masks
method.threshold_rule: recorded primary threshold of each index (|Δ| ≥ t)
method.geometry: rasterio.features.shapes on the native UTM grid, projected to WGS84 (pyproj); no hand-drawn geometry
method.area_convention: pixel count × pixel area on the projected analysis grid

interpretation.title: ▼ Candidate NDVI decrease · Region 01
interpretation.observed_measurement: Mean ΔNDVI -0.366 index units (median -0.381 index units) at the recorded threshold |Δ| ≥ 0.15; 47 px = 0.47 ha = 0.02 % of the 237,774-px shared-valid footprint.
interpretation.meaning: A NDVI decrease here marks where the later forest composite reads lower in NDVI. In this terrain the validity footprint is complete, but terrain shadow and illumination geometry can still colour the spectral comparison.
explanations: Terrain shadow and illumination differences between acquisitions.
Canopy density or phenology differences between the windows.
Canopy disturbance — candidate only; independent evidence would be required to establish it.
interpretation.evidence_strength: Shared-valid coverage for this comparison is 100.00 % of the AOI (237,774 px). The region is a connected 47-px component at a stated threshold — adjacent pixels are not independent observations, so no significance is claimed. Candidate spectral signal with stated thresholds, not independently verified change.
cannot_conclude: That deforestation occurred (no independent verification).
A distinction between shadow effects and real canopy change.

source.method: frozen M1 difference rasters + common-valid masks

dataset.license: Copernicus Sentinel data: free, open and unrestricted use with attribution (ESA Copernicus data policy). Catalogue: Element 84 Earth Search, AWS Open Data.
dataset.attribution: Contains modified Copernicus Sentinel data, processed by ESA; L2A products distributed by the Element 84 Earth Search STAC catalogue (AWS Open Data).

input_measurements.index_label: observed index difference (later - earlier); not a land-cover verdict
input_measurements.delta_definition: I_later(p) - I_earlier(p) on the shared analysis grid
input_measurements.threshold_rule: |ΔI| ≥ t, inclusive; sign selects the candidate direction

spatial_measurements.area_units: ha (projected analysis grid, pixel count × pixel area)

masking_and_cloud_limitations: Topographic shadow and canopy structure complicate index interpretation.
Composites are robust within-period summaries of a few observations, not a dense time series; inter-annual change is represented by two period composites only.
Index differences are candidate spectral signals. They are not verified deforestation, wetland loss, construction, glacier damage or any other causal land-cover label.
Cloud, shadow and saturated-pixel exclusion relies on the provider SCL product; terrain shadow is not independently re-derived.
Surface reflectance is the provider L2A product; no independent atmospheric correction is performed.
Areas are planimetric on the documented projected grid; UTM scale distortion at this AOI is small but nonzero.

threshold_sensitivity.method: candidate mask relabelled at t ± 0.05; the containing component of the recorded region is tracked (max-overlap component)
threshold_sensitivity.label: spatially persistent across tested thresholds
threshold_sensitivity.label_rules: spatially persistent across tested thresholds: ≥ 80 % of the region's pixels remain candidates at t + 0.05 AND the containing component area stays within 2× at both neighbour thresholds; threshold-sensitive: < 50 % retained at t + 0.05 OR the component grows/shrinks beyond 3×/⅓× at a neighbour; otherwise moderately threshold-sensitive

confounding_factors: Terrain shadow and illumination differences between acquisitions.
Canopy density or phenology differences between the windows.
Canopy disturbance — candidate only; independent evidence would be required to establish it.

relationships.overlap_rule: equal-area UTM intersection ≥ 10 % of the smaller region

method_provenance.algorithm: threshold candidate mask → 4-connected components (scipy.ndimage.label) → MMU filter → top-K selection

interpretation.meaning: A NDWI decrease here marks where the later forest composite reads lower in NDWI. In this terrain the validity footprint is complete, but terrain shadow and illumination geometry can still colour the spectral comparison.
explanations: Terrain shadow and illumination differences between acquisitions.
Canopy density or phenology differences between the windows.

interpretation.evidence_strength: Shared-valid coverage for this comparison is 100.00 % of the AOI (237,774 px). Candidate spectral signal with stated thresholds, not independently verified change.
cannot_conclude: That deforestation occurred (no independent verification).
A distinction between shadow effects and real canopy change.

input_measurements.delta_definition: I_later(p) - I_earlier(p) on the shared analysis grid
input_measurements.threshold_rule: |ΔI| ≥ t, inclusive; sign selects the candidate direction

spatial_measurements.area_units: ha (projected analysis grid, pixel count × pixel area)

masking_and_cloud_limitations: Topographic shadow and canopy structure complicate index interpretation.
Composites are robust within-period summaries of a few observations, not a dense time series; inter-annual change is represented by two period composites only.
Index differences are candidate spectral signals. They are not verified deforestation, wetland loss, construction, glacier damage or any other causal land-cover label.
Cloud, shadow and saturated-pixel exclusion relies on the provider SCL product; terrain shadow is not independently re-derived.
Surface reflectance is the provider L2A product; no independent atmospheric correction is performed.
Areas are planimetric on the documented projected grid; UTM scale distortion at this AOI is small but nonzero.

threshold_sensitivity.method: candidate mask relabelled at t ± 0.05; the containing component of the recorded region is tracked (max-overlap component)
threshold_sensitivity.label: threshold-sensitive
threshold_sensitivity.label_rules: spatially persistent across tested thresholds: ≥ 80 % of the region's pixels remain candidates at t + 0.05 AND the containing component area stays within 2× at both neighbour thresholds; threshold-sensitive: < 50 % retained at t + 0.05 OR the component grows/shrinks beyond 3×/⅓× at a neighbour; otherwise moderately threshold-sensitive

confounding_factors: Terrain shadow and illumination differences between acquisitions.
Canopy density or phenology differences between the windows.
Canopy disturbance — candidate only; independent evidence would be required to establish it.

relationships.overlap_rule: equal-area UTM intersection ≥ 10 % of the smaller region
